headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 29, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Grayson Rodriguez earning the win. Wenceel Pérez led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory, while the Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Baltimore Orioles.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams across the league. Graham Ashcraft, the Cincinnati Reds' right-handed pitcher, has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a right forearm UCL sprain. Additionally, the Minnesota Twins' Kendry Rojas has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 26, 2026, with left elbow inflammation.

The Detroit Tigers made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Angels Soar Past Tigers 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Grayson Rodriguez earning the win. Wenceel Pérez led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in South Side Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 6-2 loss to the Chicago White Sox, with Randal Grichuk leading the Twins' offense with 3 RBIs on 1 hit in 4 at-bats. Davis Martin earned the win for the White Sox, pitching 6.0 innings with 5 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Red Sox 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory. Ronald Acuña Jr. led the Braves' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Orioles in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save.

top_news.title: **Reds' Graham Ashcraft Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Graham Ashcraft, the Cincinnati Reds' right-handed pitcher, has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a right forearm UCL sprain. This move is a result of a recent update to his status.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez.
